messages:
Priya: Heads up — saw a ~2x credit spike for tenant-42 between 03:00-03:05 UTC. Looks like a consumer replay produced duplicate token records downstream. Console preview shows fewer tokens than the ledger. Anyone else see this pattern?
Owen: I saw alerts. Replay consumer restarted during that window, it may have reprocessed offsets.
Julian: Can you paste the ingest shard IDs or offsets? want to check idempotency keys.
Priya: Offsets: topic=ingest-events partition=2 offsets 554321..554987. Also seen a lot of messages with missing route_hint metadata.
Beth: missing route_hint would cause route enrichment to default to legacy routing which has different token attribution, might explain console vs ledger mismatch.
Devon: Quick debug: run this query to find duplicated event ids in the aggregator table:
```
SELECT event_id, count(*) FROM metering.agg_events
WHERE recorded_at BETWEEN '2024-08-16T03:00:00Z' AND '2024-08-16T03:10:00Z'
GROUP BY event_id HAVING count(*) > 1;
```
Priya: Ran that — ~1.9k event_ids duplicated, many from partition=2. duplication looks like exact duplicates (same token_count).
Owen: Two plausible causes: consumer retry + no-once semantics in enrichment, or upstream connector replaying with slightly different headers so dedupe-key didn't match.
Julian: Our dedupe window is 5m currently. If the consumer replayed after 7m then duplicates slip through. What's the replay timing?
Priya: Restart at 03:02, but the consumer replayed back to 02:58 for that partition (so overlap). Some duplicates fell outside the 5m dedupe window.
Beth: That aligns with console preview — preview uses preview-aggregates that apply a conservative compact window and drop duplicates differently, ledger uses final aggregation with event-level ingestion time.
Devon: We need to decide whether to: (A) extend dedupe window to 15m, (B) make enrichment idempotent using event-generational keys, or (C) reject replays above X minutes in the connector. Thoughts?
Owen: Extending to 15m will increase memory/time for the aggregator; not great for high-throughput tenants. Idempotent keys seems cleaner but requires producer changes.
Julian: Quick mitigation: add a soft-deploy that tags replays in the pipeline (metering-bot can emit replay flag) so invoice preview can exclude flagged windows until reconciled. Then implement idempotent keys as longer-term.
metering-bot: detected consumer restart on ingest-consumer-2 at 2024-08-16T03:02:12Z — replay range 1765425600..1765432110 (approx). Flagging events with header x-replay=true for visibility.
Priya: Love that. If meter-bot tags, console can surface a banner: "Data in this preview window may include replayed events". That will reduce confusion for SRE and Billing.
Beth: Also want an alert when duplicate event_id rate > 0.1% for a tenant over 10m. Can someone add to the rulebook?
Owen: I'll open a quick PR to the alerting playbook and add a temporary runbook section for "replay-contraction".
Devon: For long-term, I'll sketch idempotent enrichment: include producer-generated uuid + ingest-timestamp truncated to minute as dedupe-key. That will survive consumer restarts.
Julian: Note: route_hint being missing is a separate issue. If enrichment fills route_hint lazily (later in pipeline) duplicates that miss route_hint on first pass may be attributed differently. We should ensure route_hint enrichment is before dedupe step.
Priya: Filed two tickets: ENG-1248 route_hint enrichment order, ENG-1249 preview-replay-banner + alert. Assigning ENG-1248 to Julian, ENG-1249 to Owen.
Beth: Can we also add a small reconciliation job to backfill/fix tenant invoices when we detect >5% delta between preview and ledger for a billing window? Not auto-correct, just surface to finance.
Owen: Good call. I'll add a slow job that computes per-tenant delta and posts to #billing-ops daily.
Priya: TL;DR: mitigate with meter-bot tagging + preview banner; add alert; short-term extend dedupe policy by config flag for affected tenants only; long-term implement idempotent keys and reorder enrichment. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Julian: I'll start the order-change PR and ping infra for a canary.
metering-bot: noted assignments: ENG-1248 (Julian), ENG-1249 (Owen).
Priya: I'll run a one-off reconcile for tenant-42 and post results here tomorrow morning.
Devon: Heads-up: if we change dedupe window per-tenant, we need to reflect that in cost SLOs (memory) — will loop in infra.
Beth: Thanks team. I'll update the billing runbook with the new alert and the reconcile checklist.
